scan_notes: Reviewed the exact two-file diff, surrounding LR simulator/model/control code, frontend editable-grid behavior, CSV row sharing, and the worktree status. The worktree is clean with no untracked files. Source inspection confirms the model returns per-cohort scenario dicts containing `label`, both intended render sites now use the helper, Offer A remains on separate branches, and the tests detect dict/string regressions, wrong-cohort constants, and truncation. Tests were not executed because the filesystem is read-only; runtime conclusions are inferred from source.

findings.title: Empty authored labels are replaced with “Funded”
findings.evidence: The changed render site uses `status = _scn_label(i) or "Funded"`; the Cohort Detail site repeats the same fallback at line 526. `_scn_label` returns the authored label unchanged, including `""`. Empty text is reachable because `controls._grid_cell` accepts text cells as `str(cell)` and the frontend commits raw text, including an empty string. This is source-inferred; tests could not be run in the read-only workspace.
findings.failure_scenario: A user clears the label of the selected Offer-B scenario in the editable grid. The model stores `label: ""`, but both the sigma grid and Cohort Detail/CSV render `Funded` instead of the exactly authored empty label. All new tests still pass because none submits an empty label and `Funded` is treated as an allowed outcome.
findings.suggested_fix: At both sites, fall back only on `None`: assign the helper result to a variable and use `label if label is not None else "Funded"`. Add an empty-label case to the authored-label test.

overall_explanation: The primary fix is correct for ordinary and long scenario labels and is well-covered across both render sites. One reachable falsy-label edge case violates the explicit exact-label requirement and escapes the tests.
